## Purpose and Entry Points
Kimi CLI is a Python terminal AI agent for software-development and shell tasks. It can run interactively, expose an ACP server for IDEs, and launch local web/visualization interfaces. Primary package entry points are `src/kimi_cli/__main__.py`, `src/kimi_cli/app.py`, and CLI subcommands under `src/kimi_cli/cli/`.

## Runtime Composition
The core runtime is Python, packaged as `kimi-cli`; `uv` is the development/runtime launcher. The repository is a monorepo containing reusable Python packages: agent/LLM primitives in `packages/kosong/`, local/SSH execution abstractions in `packages/kaos/`, and a public SDK wrapper in `sdks/kimi-sdk/`. Node/Vite React applications provide browser UI and session visualization in `web/` and `vis/`.

## Agent Orchestration
The interactive application loads configuration, credentials, agents, session state, and the selected UI before constructing the agent loop. The “soul” layer owns turn execution: prompt/context assembly, dynamic mode injections, slash commands, tool dispatch, compaction, approvals, and LLM interaction. Key paths: `src/kimi_cli/soul/kimisoul.py`, `src/kimi_cli/soul/agent.py`, `src/kimi_cli/session.py`.

## LLM, Messages, and Tools Boundary
`kosong` defines provider-neutral messages, tool-call/result models, generation flow, and MCP tool adapters. Kimi CLI consumes that abstraction rather than binding its agent loop directly to one model API. Built-in tools form the privileged local-action boundary—filesystem reads/writes, shell execution, web fetch/search, user questions, plans, and background control. Key paths: `packages/kosong/src/kosong/_generate.py`, `packages/kosong/src/kosong/chat_provider/`, `src/kimi_cli/tools/`.

## Providers, Authentication, and MCP
Provider adapters support Kimi plus OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, and Google GenAI integrations; OAuth/API-key resolution is isolated in the auth layer. MCP is both a managed external-tool integration and an ad-hoc CLI/ACP capability, with tool results normalized through the core tool model. Key paths: `packages/kosong/src/kosong/chat_provider/kimi.py`, `src/kimi_cli/auth/oauth.py`, `src/kimi_cli/acp/mcp.py`.

## Interfaces and Protocols
The default terminal UI renders streaming agent state and mediates interactive approvals/questions. ACP exposes Kimi CLI as an IDE agent server. A separate JSON-RPC-style wire protocol supports structured clients and streaming control, while local HTTP apps serve the web chat UI and session visualizer. Key paths: `src/kimi_cli/ui/shell/`, `src/kimi_cli/acp/server.py`, `src/kimi_cli/wire/server.py`, `src/kimi_cli/web/app.py`, `src/kimi_cli/vis/app.py`.

## Persistence, Extension, and Async Work
Sessions and session state are durable boundaries shared by terminal, ACP, wire, web, and visualization surfaces. Background agents have separate manager/worker/store components. Plugins, skills, hooks, configured agent specifications, and subagents extend the base agent without changing its central loop. Key paths: `src/kimi_cli/session_state.py`, `src/kimi_cli/background/manager.py`, `src/kimi_cli/plugin/manager.py`, `src/kimi_cli/subagents/runner.py`.

## Frontends and Delivery
`web/` is a React/Vite chat client consuming generated OpenAPI bindings and backend session APIs; `vis/` is a distinct React/Vite session/context/wire analytics UI. Production builds embed web assets into the Python package. GitHub Actions provide package-specific CI and release workflows; standalone binary packaging is represented by `kimi.spec`. Key paths: `web/src/main.tsx`, `vis/src/main.tsx`, `scripts/build_web.py`, `.github/workflows/release-kimi-cli.yml`.
